scripts.generate:types: CI=1 WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler types scripts/worker-configuration.d.ts --config scripts/wrangler.toml --env-interface CloudflareBindings && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='scripts/worker-configuration.d.ts';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/[ \\t]+$/gm,''));"
scripts.types:check: sh -c 'before=$(shasum -a 256 scripts/worker-configuration.d.ts | cut -d " " -f 1); npm run generate:types >/dev/null; after=$(shasum -a 256 scripts/worker-configuration.d.ts | cut -d " " -f 1); if [ "$before" != "$after" ]; then echo "scripts/worker-configuration.d.ts 已过期，请运行 npm run generate:types" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --config scripts/wrangler.toml --local --file schema/citizenserve.sql
